opportunity_catalog.title: Review 3 Illustrative CRM seats by the open notice deadline

estimate.formula: 0 lower bound; modeled upper capacity = reviewable seats * normalized monthly unit price * 12; realization only after approved renewal change and invoice verification

overlap.reason: Inactive assigned and unassigned seat populations are disjoint; this opportunity combines them once for this application renewal.

non_mutating_review_steps: Confirm the notice window remains open through 2026-10-01 for the stated renewal.
Confirm the users and entitlements with the application owner.
Confirm contractual reduction rights and notice deadline.
Approve the renewal change outside this tool.
Verify realized savings against later invoices.

opportunity_aggregates.label: Overlap-safe annual estimated opportunity range
opportunity_aggregates.inclusion_rule: Include only identified, under-review, or approved opportunities with independent or none-known overlap disposition whose deterministic overlap group appears exactly once across the complete opportunity catalog. Exclude every candidate in repeated groups because v0.2 has no canonical selection or precedence mechanism, and exclude opportunities related to invalid-metric findings; also exclude rejected, closed, implemented-pending-verification, potential, nested, and exclusive entries. All candidates remain cataloged and estimates are not verified savings.

disclosures: All data in this report is illustrative and does not describe a real customer environment.
Every displayed number references a canonical producer metric; the Command Center does not invent savings, anomalies, or forecasts.
Metrics with different periods or accounting boundaries are not added into a single technology-spend total.
Opportunity ranges are estimates, not verified savings; potential, nested, and exclusive overlaps are excluded from aggregates.
AI costs with potential cloud-billing overlap and modeled resilience exposure remain non-additive at the executive boundary.
One or more producer results are partial; inspect their quality issues before decisions.
